# Naim Kingkon

He builds AI agents, automation pipelines, and serverless systems on AWS that run in production. He has worked with clients and employers since 2021, mostly UK based teams working remotely.

## Products

- Visibilitas AI (2026): an AI visibility checker that reports whether AI assistants recommend a brand. Builds on self written scrapers rather than a paid SERP API. https://visibilitas-ai.pages.dev
- Writing Adventure (2026): an installable writing PWA giving feedback that is only shown if every quoted line appears verbatim in the user's text. https://writing-adventure.pages.dev
- Terrific (2026): real time incident monitoring with an AI layer that drafts status updates. https://github.com/Kingkon963/terrific
